name: minimal
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Document, Keys.

name: omit-zero
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Keys, zero values are omitted.

name: example
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys, the Variable key order puts `example` right after `description`, and a zero `example` is omitted. Scalars and Multi-line strings: `example` is written like `description`. The value `Engineering manager` is the brief's own illustration.

name: strings
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Scalars. Each value is one clause of the plain or quoted rule, and the reserved words come from 0030's format guards.

name: multiline
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Multi-line strings.

name: answers
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Answers. Values follow the domain model's Value kinds, and the names come from the ACME example.

name: unknown-fields
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys, Lists, Unknown field values. 0030: unknown fields are preserved.

name: key-order
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: the key order table. Field names are from the domain model.

name: conditions
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Keys, isSettled. Condition syntax is from docs/reference/section-template-schema/conditions.md.

name: list-order
source: Hand-written. Every array field holds several items out of sorted order, with a repeat in some, so a version that sorts, reverses, or drops repeats fails. Contract rule: Lists, and the order of items in a plan.

name: acme
source: The ACME example plan, which is written in canonical form, so the example file is the expected output. The input JSON was first converted from that file with Ruby's YAML loader, then checked and fixed by hand: deferred answers became deferred markers, and a single run string became a one-item list.

name: section-switch
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys, the Section key order with `enabled` after `timing`, and a switch written when it holds a value, true or false. 0050: the plan section carries an optional boolean `enabled`. The ids `on` and `off` and the title `Off` show the quoting rule for reserved words.

name: section-clause
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys, the Clause key order, and a section clause always written with `enabled`, including false. 0050: the clause syntax `section` and `enabled`, in askIf and includeIf. The id `n` shows the quoting rule.

name: enabled-unknown
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Unknown fields are written after the known keys. `enabled` is a known key of a Section only, so at the plan level it is an unknown field, and `section` is a known key of a Clause only.

name: empty-answer
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Problems, empty-answer, for an answer and for an item of isOneOf or isNotOneOf.

name: ambiguous-check
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Problems, ambiguous-check. The domain model says a Check has exactly one of run, ask, or env.

name: unknown-field-collision
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Problems, unknown-field-collision.

name: empty-item
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Problems, empty-item. Dropping an item would shift the list.

name: enabled-collision
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Problems, unknown-field-collision. `enabled` is a known key of a Section.

name: sub-section
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys, the Section key order with `parent` right after `includeIf`, written like `title` (quoted for the reserved word `on` and for `Team: core`), omitted when empty. 0070: a section may name a parent section by id, and the file stays a flat list. The ids and the parent `missing` show that the encoder checks no reference.

name: parent-unknown
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Keys, an unknown field is a collision only when its key is a known key of that type, and `parent` is not a key of a Plan. 0070: `parent` is a Section field only.

name: parent-collision
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Problems, unknown-field-collision. `parent` is a known key of a Section (0070), so it collides whether or not the section holds a parent.

name: id-origin
source: Hand-written. ADR 0075 (Identity and origin) and the domain model (Plan, Origin). Contract rules: Keys, the Plan key order `schemaVersion`, `id`, `provenance`, `origin`, `variables`, `answers`, `sections`, then unknown fields, and the Origin key order `planId`, `source`, `contentHash`, `refreshedOn`. A UUID and a date start with a digit, so they are quoted. A hash that starts with a digit is quoted, and a URL starting with a letter is plain.

name: id-only
source: Hand-written. Domain model: `origin` is present in a personal plan only, so a plan with an `id` and no origin writes no `origin` key. Contract rules: Keys, a zero value is omitted. An id that starts with a letter is plain.

name: origin-planid-refreshed
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys. Each zero key of an Origin is omitted by itself, and an empty `id` is omitted. This writes only `planId` and `refreshedOn`.

name: origin-source-hash
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys. This writes only `source` and `contentHash`, with `provenance` before `origin` and no `id`. A path starting with `/` is plain.

name: origin-quoting
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Scalars. An `id`, a `planId`, a `source`, and a `contentHash` are written by the same rules as any string: `null`, `Team: core`, and `on` are quoted by the reserved-word and `: ` rules, and a hash such as `0e1234` is quoted because it starts with a digit.

name: origin-unknown
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys, an unknown field collides only when its key is a known key of that type. `planId`, `source`, `contentHash`, and `refreshedOn` are keys of an Origin and not of a Plan, and `origin` is not a key of a Section, so none collides. Unknown fields are written after the known keys.

name: id-origin-collision
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Problems, unknown-field-collision. `id` and `origin` are known keys of a Plan (ADR 0075), so an unknown field with either key collides, whether or not the plan holds an id. Problems come in key order, and the other unknown field, `x-ok`, is fine.

name: directory-shared
source: Hand-written YAML for the shared plan in contracts/plan/testdata/directory.plan.json. ADR 0080 (Directory) and the domain model (Directory, Contact, Role, Team): the 0080 example. Contract rules: Keys, the directory tables. `@sam` and `#it-help` are quoted because they start with `@` and `#`, `U01ABC123` and the emails are plain because they start with a letter, and the plan id is quoted because it starts with a digit.

name: directory-order
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys. The directory is written after `origin` and before `variables`, its keys are `contacts`, `roles`, `teams`, and each item writes its fields in the order of the tables. Contacts, roles, teams, and holders are out of sorted order, with repeats and two items that share an id, and are written as held. A team's `holders` role ids, which the Go map holds with no order, are written in ascending byte order: `2fa-owner`, `Zed`, `buddy`, `lead`, `qa`. A role's own `holders` keep their order.

name: directory-omit-zero
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys, a key with a zero value is omitted. A contact with one field writes that one key, so five contacts write five different keys. An empty list of holders and an empty or absent team `holders` map are omitted, and a role or team that holds only its holders or only a name is not an empty item.

name: directory-only-teams
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys. An empty `contacts` and an empty `roles` are omitted, so `directory` holds `teams` alone.

name: directory-vacant-role
source: Hand-written. 0080: a team's entry for a role replaces the role's own holders, and an empty entry makes the role vacant for that team. Contract rules: Keys, a map entry is always written. A team's `holders` entry with no holder is written `manager: []`, so reading the file back keeps the role vacant. The entries are in byte order.

name: directory-quoting
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Scalars, Multi-line strings. Every directory field, holder, and role id key is written by the string rules. Plain: `sam-okafor`, `U01ABC123`, an email that starts with a letter, `$HOME`, `<noreply@acme.example>`, `/it`. Quoted: `@sam`, `#it-help`, `@42`, an id, a slack id, an email, or a holder that starts with a digit such as `42`, `007`, `1password@acme.example`, and `2026-10-15`, the reserved words `true`, `on`, `null`, `y`, `n`, `no`, `yes`, and `deferred`, `Sam: Okafor`, `Sam #1`, `ends:`, a leading space, and `Ünal@acme.example`. As keys of a team's `holders`: `2fa`, `@it`, `deferred`, `n`, and `on` are quoted, and `Z`, `engineering-manager`, and `it help` are plain. A name with a newline is a literal block, `|-` with no final newline and `|` with one. An empty email is omitted.

name: directory-team-contact
source: Hand-written. ADR 0080: a team may name a `contact`, the id of a directory contact. Contract rules: Keys, the Team row is `id`, `name`, `contact`, `holders`. `contact` is written after `name` and before `holders`, whether or not the team has a name or holders, and omitted when empty. `platform-team` is plain. A team's contact is not a holder, so it never appears under `holders`, and a vacant entry beside it is still written `[]`. A contact that names no contact of the directory, repeats, and case are written as held.

name: directory-team-contact-quoting
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Scalars, Multi-line strings. A team's `contact` is written by the string rules, like a holder. Plain: `platform-team`, `$HOME`, `/oncall`, `<noreply@acme.example>`, and an email that starts with a letter. Quoted: an id that starts with a digit such as `42` and `2fa-team`, the reserved words `true`, `on`, `null`, `y`, `no`, and `deferred`, `@oncall`, `#platform`, a date, an email that starts with a digit, `Sam: Okafor`, a leading space, `ends:`, `a #b`, and `Ünal@acme.example`. Text with a newline is a literal block, `|-` with no final newline and `|` with one.

name: directory-team-contact-only
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys, and Problems, `encode.empty-item`. A team that holds only a `contact` writes that one key, so it is not an empty item, and the directory that holds it is written. The empty `contacts` and `roles` are omitted.

name: directory-team-contact-empty-items
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Problems, `encode.empty-item`. A team with a `contact` is not empty. A team with an empty `contact` and nothing else, and one with an empty `contact` and an empty `holders` map, write no keys. A team with an empty `contact` and a vacant entry writes the entry, so it is not empty.

name: directory-section-unknown
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys, an unknown field collides only when its key is a known key of that type. A section's `directory` and `x-directory` unknown fields are written as any other, after `steps`, and a step's `directory` stays a string.

name: directory-blank
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys. A `directory` that holds nothing is omitted, so the file holds only `schemaVersion`.

name: directory-collision
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys, and Problems, `encode.unknown-field-collision`. `directory` is a known key of a plan, so an unknown field of the plan with that key collides, as `id` and `origin` do. It is reported once, its value is not examined, and `x-ok` is written no problem.

name: directory-empty-items
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Problems, `encode.empty-item`. A contact, a role, or a team that would write no keys cannot be dropped without shifting the list. A role with an empty `holders` and a team with an empty `holders` map are empty. A team whose map has an entry with no holder is not empty, and a contact, role, or team with an id is not.

name: directory-problem-order
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Problems come in the order of their places in the canonical file. The directory is written before `variables` and `sections`, so its problem comes first.

name: plan-links
source: Hand-written. ADR 0090 and the domain model (Plan): a plan has an optional text `planUrl` and an optional text `resultsPath`. Contract rules: Keys, the Plan key order `schemaVersion`, `id`, `provenance`, `origin`, `planUrl`, `resultsPath`, `directory`, `variables`, `answers`, `sections`, then unknown fields, and a zero value is omitted. A URL that starts with a letter and a path template that starts with a letter and holds braces are plain, because the string rule quotes only a first character other than a letter, `$`, `/`, or `<`, and a `{` inside is allowed.

name: plan-links-url-only
source: Hand-written. ADR 0090 and the domain model (Plan): a plan has an optional text `planUrl` and an optional text `resultsPath`. Contract rules: Keys, the Plan key order `schemaVersion`, `id`, `provenance`, `origin`, `planUrl`, `resultsPath`, `directory`, `variables`, `answers`, `sections`, then unknown fields, and a zero value is omitted. With no `resultsPath`, only `planUrl` is written, between `origin` and `directory`.

name: plan-links-path-only
source: Hand-written. ADR 0090 and the domain model (Plan): a plan has an optional text `planUrl` and an optional text `resultsPath`. Contract rules: Keys, the Plan key order `schemaVersion`, `id`, `provenance`, `origin`, `planUrl`, `resultsPath`, `directory`, `variables`, `answers`, `sections`, then unknown fields, and a zero value is omitted. With no `planUrl`, only `resultsPath` is written, between `origin` and `directory`. A path that starts with `/` is plain.

name: plan-links-brace-first
source: Hand-written. ADR 0090 and the domain model (Plan): a plan has an optional text `planUrl` and an optional text `resultsPath`. Contract rules: Keys, the Plan key order `schemaVersion`, `id`, `provenance`, `origin`, `planUrl`, `resultsPath`, `directory`, `variables`, `answers`, `sections`, then unknown fields, and a zero value is omitted. Contract rules: Scalars. A first character other than a letter, `$`, `/`, or `<` is quoted. A template that starts with `{` must be quoted, because a plain `{` starts a flow map. A host that starts with a digit is quoted.

name: plan-links-punctuation
source: Hand-written. ADR 0090 and the domain model (Plan): a plan has an optional text `planUrl` and an optional text `resultsPath`. Contract rules: Keys, the Plan key order `schemaVersion`, `id`, `provenance`, `origin`, `planUrl`, `resultsPath`, `directory`, `variables`, `answers`, `sections`, then unknown fields, and a zero value is omitted. Contract rules: Scalars. ` #` makes a string quoted, and a path that starts with `.` is quoted.

name: plan-links-plain-punctuation
source: Hand-written. ADR 0090 and the domain model (Plan): a plan has an optional text `planUrl` and an optional text `resultsPath`. Contract rules: Keys, the Plan key order `schemaVersion`, `id`, `provenance`, `origin`, `planUrl`, `resultsPath`, `directory`, `variables`, `answers`, `sections`, then unknown fields, and a zero value is omitted. Contract rules: Scalars. A `:` not followed by a space and a `#` not preceded by a space do not force quotes, and a first character `$` is plain.

name: plan-links-reserved-words
source: Hand-written. ADR 0090 and the domain model (Plan): a plan has an optional text `planUrl` and an optional text `resultsPath`. Contract rules: Keys, the Plan key order `schemaVersion`, `id`, `provenance`, `origin`, `planUrl`, `resultsPath`, `directory`, `variables`, `answers`, `sections`, then unknown fields, and a zero value is omitted. Contract rules: Scalars. The reserved words and the Text value `deferred` are quoted, as for any string.

name: plan-links-blank
source: Hand-written. ADR 0090 and the domain model (Plan): a plan has an optional text `planUrl` and an optional text `resultsPath`. Contract rules: Keys, the Plan key order `schemaVersion`, `id`, `provenance`, `origin`, `planUrl`, `resultsPath`, `directory`, `variables`, `answers`, `sections`, then unknown fields, and a zero value is omitted. Empty text is omitted, so a plan that holds neither writes neither key.

name: plan-links-section-unknown
source: Hand-written. ADR 0090 and the domain model (Plan): a plan has an optional text `planUrl` and an optional text `resultsPath`. Contract rules: Keys, the Plan key order `schemaVersion`, `id`, `provenance`, `origin`, `planUrl`, `resultsPath`, `directory`, `variables`, `answers`, `sections`, then unknown fields, and a zero value is omitted. An unknown field collides only when its key is a known key of that type, and `planUrl`, `resultsPath`, and `kind` are keys of a Plan and not of a Section, so on a section they are written as any other, after the known keys.

name: plan-links-answers-named-alike
source: Hand-written. ADR 0090 and the domain model (Plan): a plan has an optional text `planUrl` and an optional text `resultsPath`. Contract rules: Keys, the Plan key order `schemaVersion`, `id`, `provenance`, `origin`, `planUrl`, `resultsPath`, `directory`, `variables`, `answers`, `sections`, then unknown fields, and a zero value is omitted. A variable or an answer with these names is an ordinary name and a map key.

name: plan-links-collision
source: Hand-written. ADR 0090 and Contract rule: Problems, `encode.unknown-field-collision`. `planUrl` and `resultsPath` are known keys of a Plan, so an unknown field with either key collides, as `id`, `origin`, and `directory` do. A `kind` unknown field collides too, because the decoder reads `kind` as the file kind and never as an unknown field, so writing one could not be read back. Problems come in the key order, a value is not examined, and `x-ok` is fine.

name: plan-links-collision-with-values
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Problems, `encode.unknown-field-collision`. The collision holds whether or not the plan holds a value for the known key, and the plan's own values are not what is reported.
